name: Drawing Templates
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Drawing template types, presets and original motifs in categories - from woodland, farm and safari animals, pets and dinosaurs to treats, things at home, space, music and play - all rendered locally in your browser. Practice lines, shapes, hatching, stippling, textures, light and shadow, lettering, ornament borders and rosettes. Study negative space, anchor points and enlarged details, or build a motif step by step. Turn Whole Document, an individual layer, a media image or a library motif into coloring pages, paint by numbers, tracing sheets, dot drawings, symmetry exercises, scaled copying grids, photo step guides, color by code, tonal studies and more. Includes vertical, horizontal, diagonal and quarter symmetry, color by symbols, guided practice, category search, random selection, palettes and custom titles. Insert as a generator layer and reopen to adjust the template.
